|errata_history=This is the original printed state of the card, titled •Ice-Heart. The later version [[Ysanne Isard (Virtual Block 7)]] (PC-E1, the current card) has the same game text under the title •Ysanne Isard. The Virtual Block 7.1 release-sheet slip on this page prints •Ice-Heart; the Players Committee card image and the Master List slip print •Ysanne Isard (see [[Ysanne Isard (Virtual Block 7)]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): titled “•Ice-Heart” (no “(V)”) on the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010), p. 2, and on the PC website card list from 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013: “Power +3 while defending a battle with a spy. While with a non-frozen captive, attrition against opponent everywhere is +2. During your move phase, may use 1 Force to ‘break cover’ of an Undercover spy here. Immune to attrition < 3.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010), page 2, slip 5 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="cl-1271_5-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive): “Ice-Heart”</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Ysanne Isard (Virtual Block 7)]]): the title changed to “•Ysanne Isard”; the game text did not change. The PC website card list shows the new title by 14 March 2013 (the last capture with the old title is of 11 January 2013), and the Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 15) prints the card as •Ysanne Isard with new art (“Original Image courtesy of www.hydraworx.net”). The rename was probably announced in the Players Committee's “New Persona Changes” news of 29 January 2013, which was not archived.<ref name="cl-1271_5-2013-03-14">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130314031820/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-03-14] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130516000419/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-05-16] (Internet Archive): “Ysanne Isard” (these captures carry no game text)</ref><ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014).
